walkInInvite.shareHint: Send this link to the patient. They also see the invitation in the app once they sign in with this email.
walkInInvite.bannerBody: {{inviter}} invited you to connect {{pet}} with their hospital network.
walkInInvite.noDataShared: Accepting does not share any of your animal's records. The hospital will ask for your approval first.
walkInInvite.accepted: Accepted. {{network}} can now ask to enrol {{pet}}; you will be asked to approve what is shared.
walkInInvite.signInFirst: Sign in, or create an account with the email this invitation was sent to, and you can accept it. It will also appear at the top of the app.
walkInInvite.noToken: This link is missing its invitation. Open the link from the invitation again, or ask the hospital to send a new one.
